page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u0.c1m1.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture instance provisioned via the KVM hypervisor. The virtual machine provides 4 dedicated vCPUs paired with 4.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:1 core-to-memory ratio of 1.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include dedicated hardware accelerators or GPUs.

Storage and networking configurations are oriented around remote infrastructure. The instance does not bundle local storage, relying on external network-attached volumes for data retention and operating system files. Network capability includes a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

The dense 1:1 ratio between compute cores and memory limits suitability for memory-intensive applications or caching layers. However, the dedicated core allocation ensures consistent compute availability for compute-bound, low-memory operations. Best-fit use cases include parallel task execution, background worker nodes, stateless microservices, and lightweight compilation jobs.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u0.c1m1.xlarge is a compute-oriented virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor with an x86_64 CPU architecture. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs and 4.0 GB of total RAM, providing 1.0 GB of memory per core. The instance includes no bundled local storage, directing all disk I/O to remote block storage options, and contains no discrete GPU hardware. Network connectivity is configured with a baseline throughput of 2 Gbps, without bundled public IPv4 addresses. Because of the lean 1:1 memory-to-core ratio, this server presents an efficient profile for CPU-driven processes that require minimal memory footprints, such as batch workers, simple web services, and lightweight continuous integration runners.
